description_full: Goldgroup Mining Inc. operates as a mining and metals company that focuses on gold production and exploration in Mexico. The company holds a 100% interest in the San Francisco project located in the State of Sonora. It also has a 100% interest in producing Cerro Prieto heap leach gold mine located in the State of Sonora. The company is based in Vancouver, Canada.
ceo_bio: Mr. Francisco Javier Reyes de la Campa | CEO & Chairman of the Board | Compensation: $6,000 (FY2025)
financial_summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $544M market cap on $23M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +247% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

Returns on capital run at -372% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, and 12% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The company is burning through $18M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 20× is fortress-like.

Net dilution runs at 5.6% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 17% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
